'''Oznar''' was a [[City/Legends|city]] on an unknown [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. Shortly after the formation of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Oznar was inhabited by one million beings, and overseen by twenty-six Imperial enforcement [[Officer/Legends|officers]].<ref name="IC 501st">''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]''</ref>
